newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha falls with crude, n+a supported.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha falls with crude, n+a supported.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices fell sharply alongside tumbling crude oil futures on Tuesday although news of fresh refinery run cuts was supportive, especially for n+a material which is in good demand as an alternative feedstock to make gasoline, traders said.
Physical cargo prices were pegged close to June swaps levels which were seen at around $188 cif NWE in late business. July swaps were heard traded at $188.75.
"The physical has been very, very quiet," one refinery-based trader said. "Crude has been very volatile and people have been standing back waiting to see where it will end up."
Dealers said n+a material was talked at a premium of around $2 a tonne to full-range naphtha.
